name: 路客云
description: 连接已授权门店，查询房态、房价、订单与经营数据，并在确认后执行订单、房态、改价及渠道操作。
description_zh: 连接已授权门店，查询房态、房价、订单与经营数据，并在确认后执行订单、房态、改价及渠道操作。
description_en: Manage authorized properties: query rooms, rates, orders and operations; preview and confirm changes.

mcp_oauth.scopes: rooms:read rooms:write orders:read orders:write finance:read channels:read channels:write

examples_zh: 查询我授权门店今天的房态和待入住订单
统计上周入住率和平均房价
先预览指定房源明天改价为499元，等我确认后再执行
连接美团民宿，给我实际授权入口，完成后核验连接状态
examples_en: Show today's room status and upcoming arrivals for my authorized property
Show last week's occupancy and average daily rate
Preview a rate change for my selected listing and wait for confirmation
Open the supported channel connection page and verify the result after I finish
